Corollary
[Interior curvature estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0181 ↗ thm:chow-iii-perelman-pseudolocality 1. ch21:21.4\group Pseudolocality theorem

If the hypotheses of Theorem 1 hold, then, for every $\eta \in (0,1)$, \[ |\Rm |\le \frac\alpha t+\frac1{(\epsilon _0\eta r_0)^2} \] on $B_{g(0)}(x_0,(1-\eta )r_0)\times (0,(\epsilon \eta r_0)^2]$.
